name: Dig Tsho GLOF
rivers: Langmoche Khola; Bhote Koshi; Dudh Koshi
hazard_chain: ice avalanche > displacement wave > moraine breach > GLOF

name: Jure landslide and Sunkoshi dam
hazard_chain: rainfall > rockslide > landslide dam > impoundment > breach/drainage
key_sources: Shrestha & Nakagawa 2016 (Nat. Hazards 82:2029-2049); 2020 Sci. Rep. TerraSAR-X volume study
notes: Cleanest rainfall-triggered landslide-dam case; breach timing and peak discharge differ between studies

name: Melamchi debris flood
primary_trigger: heavy rainfall with snowmelt and glacial/moraine sediment
hazard_chain: rainfall + snowmelt > slope failures > temporary damming near Bhemathang > debris flood
notes: Destroyed parts of the Melamchi Water Supply Project; record official death/missing toll from NDRRMA/BIPAD

name: Bhotekoshi GLOF
hazard_chain: lake outburst > flood > bridge and hydropower damage
key_sources: secondary news reports; check ICIMOD event brief

name: Rasuwa ice-rock avalanche flood
primary_trigger: ice-rock avalanche from Langtang Lirung north face
hazard_chain: ice-rock avalanche > short-lived damming > flood surge
key_sources: ICIMOD event page; Kathmandu Post 2026-08-28; Stimson Center 2026
notes: Not rainfall-triggered and not a GLOF; DHM reported no heavy rainfall immediately before; use as counter-example to rainfall-based approaches
